title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1982-04-06
source: flac16/48kHz; Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Bob Wagner's Sony TC-D5M > Jim's Sony TC-D5M (Maxell UDXLII-C90)Transfer Info:Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp (24-bit/96 kHz) > Adobe Audition 3.01 (24-bit/96 kHz) > TLH flac2496; 24-bit > 16-bit via dBpoweramp

ai_review.summary: High‑energy late‑70s style show captured on an excellent audience tape, with a rocking first set and an over‑the‑top second set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the fresh audience/PA transfer from Jim Wise’s master cassette, calling it a “nice recording” that captures crowd excitement far better than the mediocre soundboard source. The performance is described as a straight‑ahead rocker in the first set and an “over‑the‑top” second set, giving listeners a vivid taste of early‑80s Dead energy.

ai_rating.rationale: Both 5‑star reviews consistently praise the recording’s clarity and the show’s energetic performance, indicating an exceptional audience source and a strong musical outing.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fresh cassette transfer by Jim Wise; clear PA mix with strong crowd presence; preferred over the mediocre soundboard alternative.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as a tight rocker reminiscent of the late‑70s, followed by an exuberant second set that pushes the band to “11,” keeping the crowd fully engaged.
